# Repository instructions

- Write concise, original Markdown with descriptive headings, meaningful link text, and reproducible examples.
- Pair English pages in `docs/` with French pages under `docs/fr/`. Match their relative paths and keep objectives, examples, and sources aligned.
- Verify exam scope against the official Microsoft Learn GH-300 study guide. Verify product behavior, plan availability, and policies against official GitHub or Microsoft documentation. Include only real references you verified.
- Date historical behavior and label the applicable version or release status. Present current functionality in its own clearly identified context.
- Use original practice material. Exclude leaked or recalled exam questions.
- Preserve keyboard navigation, visible focus, semantic headings, and readable contrast in light and dark themes.
- Keep TypeScript configuration typed and readable. Use VitePress conventions for routing, localization, and local search.
- Run the production build and check the changed routes in both locales.
